# testing_root_union_write_only (Resource)

RootUnionWriteOnly Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_root_union_write_only" "my_rootunionwriteonly" {
  alpha = {
    credentials = {
      client_id     = "...my_client_id..."
      client_secret = "...my_client_secret..."
    }
    name = "...my_name..."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alpha` (Attributes) First root-union variant with a nested writeOnly property. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alpha))
- `beta` (Attributes) Second root-union variant nesting writeOnly properties inside an array of objects, verifying the prior collection is sourced from the variant captured before reallocation rather than the freshly reset variant. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--beta))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `name` (String) Resource name
